blocks.html: Robinsons Malls is offering a faster and more convenient way of commuting for everyone as it launches #MoveWithGrab. In collaboration with Grab, the leading transportation network company in Southeast Asia, #MoveWithGrab is a point-to-point ride-sharing service where commuters can comfortably head to their offices or back to their homes during rush hours in the morning and at night. At present, professionals and residents in busy areas like the Ortigas Center demand for better transport alternatives when getting in and out of the business district. Robinsons Malls’ #MoveWithGrab is an addition to the list of best transport alternatives as it offers the comfort, security and safety of the mall’s queuing area and reliability of Grab’s booking system. A pilot run for this service will start on May 4, 2017, Thursday. During morning rush hour, commuters near Robinsons Metro East heading to Ortigas Center may book a ride with movewithgrab.com by choosing the route: Robinsons Metro East to Robinsons Galleria, and preferred pick-up time: 6:00AM, 6:30AM or 7:00AM. The pick-up point is at Robinsons Metro East’s Grab Kiosk, Driver's Lounge Area near the Transport Terminal entrance. In the evening, commuters heading back to Pasig & Marikina areas along Marcos Highway can again book with movewithgrab.com by choosing the route: Robinsons Galleria to Robinsons Metro East, clicking their preferred pick-up time: 6:00PM, 6:30PM and 7:00PM and conveniently wait for their ride at Robinsons Galleria’s Grab Booth in front of TGI Friday's, along ADB Avenue driveway. The introductory fixed fare for the pilot run is ₱60.00 per trip and will employ spacious six (6) seater vehicles. To know more about #MoveWithGrab, check out the website at www.movewithgrab.com
